supporting_pages.title: Settings \_|\_ Cloud Logging \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: If set to true, the Default sink in newly created projects and folders will created in a disabled state.

DefaultSinkConfig Describes the custom Default sink configuration that is used to override the built-in Default sink configuration in newly created resource containers, such as projects or folders.
